strings.zh: 欢迎光临,{SCROLL}请问您要到几楼。{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Thank you for shopping with us today.{SCROLL}To which floor may I take you? {VAR:0200:0}
I look forward to serving you again.

strings.notes: US 0598/4 | RV036: meaning: zh 到了 ‘here we are’, not a question

strings.en: First floor has the Service Counter{NEWLINE}and the main entrance.

strings.zh: ２楼　货品齐全{NEWLINE}训练师超市。
strings.en: Second floor has the fully stocked{NEWLINE}Trainer’s Market.
strings.notes: US 0598/6 | RV036: addition: zh 货品齐全 ‘fully stocked’ only

strings.zh: ３楼　让精灵更强大{NEWLINE}果子超市。
strings.en: Third floor has the Berry Market{NEWLINE}to make your Pokémon stronger.
strings.notes: US 0598/7 US ‘Battle Collection’ replaced by the hack's 3F 果子超市 → Berry Market (as 0584 #7/#13).

strings.en: Fourth floor has the Medicine Box to{NEWLINE}improve your Pokémon’s potential.

strings.zh: ５楼　各种实用技能{NEWLINE}技能机专柜
strings.en: Fifth floor has the TM Corner,{NEWLINE}with all kinds of useful moves.

strings.zh: ６楼　休息广场{NEWLINE}有好玩的抽签柜台
strings.en: Sixth floor has the Rooftop Atrium.{NEWLINE}Don’t miss the Daily Drawing Corner!

strings.zh: 地下１楼　仓库{NEWLINE}仓库重地,闲人免入。
strings.en: The basement has the warehouse.{NEWLINE}It is not open to customers.
